_purpose: DS-156 corpus-motivated regression fixture for the completion-warrant widening in hooks/enforce-turn-shape.py (test-enforce-turn-shape.py's 'c-*' block). Each case is a SYNTHETIC template built to match a real SHAPE CLASS found in a local Claude Code transcript corpus scan - no literal transcript prose is reproduced here (per the same no-real-content discipline as turn-shape-corpus-samples.json), only the structural wording pattern that made the shape true- or false-positive during measurement.

_measurement.corpus_root: ~/.claude/projects (local developer machine, not committed - this fixture is the sanitized extract)
_measurement.note_on_final_turns: A 'final turn' is one logical assistant message (grouped by transcript message.id) that carries NO tool_use block of its own - the same 'this is a completed turn's own text, not mid-tool-call scaffolding' scope the Stop hook acts on.
_measurement.round_1_anywhere_scoped_candidate_regex: 7 candidate phrases including an anywhere-scoped 'merged/shipped and (live|deployed)' phrase
_measurement.round_1_precision_check: 50-item hand-verified random sample of newly-matched turns found 3 false positives (idx 17, 24, 36), ALL attributable to the anywhere-scoped merged/shipped phrase matching a COMPLETED SUB-ITEM's description inside a still-in-progress overall turn (CI running elsewhere, another unit still building, or a future-tense 'I'll report when it's merged and live'). In all 3, the matching text was NOT the identity line.
_measurement.round_2_fix: Moved the past-participle phrase, plus a new generalised leading done/complete sentence pattern, to an identity-line-only match (string-start anchor, never MULTILINE).
_measurement.round_2_recall_sample_purpose: still-flagged-after-fix turns, hand-checked for genuine completions the widened regex still misses (residual gap)
_measurement.round_2_recall_confirmed_residual_misses: a completion declared under a '## Done' sub-heading (not the identity line); 'Status: DONE_WITH_CONCERNS' spelling was added after this sample surfaced it as a miss
_measurement.decision_and_stoppage_warrants_checked: Measured separately (see enforce-turn-shape.py's module docstring, step 1). 7.4% of the flagged corpus sample contains 'waiting on/for' prose without a 'Waiting:' line, and 3.4% contains decision-adjacent prose without the '## Operator decisions' heading, but hand-checking found these are turns the guard is CORRECTLY nudging toward the mandated structural format, not false positives - decision/stoppage gate on a REQUIRED FORMAT the methodology itself mandates, not on recognising free-form intent the way completion/answer do. Not widened.

shape_classes_covered.structured_field_sentinel: a fixed-vocabulary field label ('Status:', 'State:') whose value is the terminal token - safe to match ANYWHERE in the domain because the label itself removes the ambiguity, not the position (cases 1, 2, 3)
shape_classes_covered.fixed_workflow_phrase: this repo's own recurring PR-review-run closing phrase ('Run complete.', 'All state files are written.') - safe anywhere for the same reason (cases 4, 5, 6)
shape_classes_covered.leading_bare_declaration: a short 'X is done/complete' sentence as the very first line of the turn (cases 7, 8, 9, 11)
shape_classes_covered.leading_past_participle: a leading 'Merged/Shipped ... live/deployed/cleaned up' declaration as the first line (case 10)
shape_classes_covered.midbody_false_positive_trap: the exact shape that produced round 1's 3 false positives - a completion-adjacent phrase appears mid-body, not on the identity line, while the turn's real state (from its identity line) is still in-progress (cases 12, 16)
shape_classes_covered.midbody_bare_participle_original_caution: the ORIGINAL (pre-DS-156) design's own caution case - a bare past participle mid-prose must never launder into a warrant (case 13)
shape_classes_covered.status_value_confusable: a structured Status: field whose VALUE is not 'done' (BLOCKED here), even though the word 'DONE' appears later in unrelated prose (case 14)
shape_classes_covered.disclosed_residual_gap: a genuine completion declared under a markdown sub-heading rather than the identity line - NOT recognised by this fix, kept as a permanent regression pin documenting the known gap rather than silently rounding it to zero (case 15)
